classAndNamePolicy: Colors represent functional classes shared by multiple places. A color is not assigned one quarter name globally. Specific map labels and their leader lines require separate unit-level review; housing estates and generic functional classes are not automatically promoted to whole neighborhoods.

selectedNativeCandidate.identityBasis: The label is printed inside the isolated southern green footprint. The chosen component has an actual closed raster-cell exterior and is not an entire map-wide green class.

geographicRegistration.controlGap: One uniquely identifiable confluence alone cannot determine source scale, rotation or anisotropic stretching. No source coordinate grid, scale bar, street base, second reviewed control or spatially distributed holdout is established.
geographicRegistration.sourcePlacementIssue: The native portrait image is stretched nonuniformly in the PDF page. Neither its native aspect ratio nor page placement establishes a geographic transform.
